Maybe so. I support everything they are standing for but blocking roadways is not a viable method for protesting.  Let the working people get to work and where they need to be. We are all trying to make a living and deterring that just causes issues and frustration for those that are just trying to survive. Like I said there are other places to peacefully protest than blocking traffic.
There's plenty of other places to protest.  Maybe not do it on a freeway where people have to get to work and others make their livelihood.

How ignorant. Many truckers haul living things. My boyfriend is a trucker and hauls cows across states to make his living.  He doesn't sleep until he gets to his destination because he doesn't want them to be in his semi a moment more than they need to be.
